DEROULEMENT.DESCRIPTION: The competition takes place over a full annual period and is based on a system of monthly rankings. It allows participants to submit, each month, their best performance achieved under standardized and fair conditions. Throughout the year, shooters may perform an unlimited number of attempts, provided they comply with shooting rules, validation procedures, and target sheet submission. The results are then processed by the organization to establish the monthly rankings, followed by the final annual ranking, which determines the prize recipients.

PROCEDURE_TIR.DECISION: At the end of the shooting session, the shooter must return the used or UNUSED target sheets to the shooting range employee.
PROCEDURE_TIR.LIMITE_MENSUELLE: Only one target sheet per shooter is accepted per month, being the sheet with the best score including bonus points.
PROCEDURE_TIR.DELAI: The target sheet must be submitted on the same day it was shot; any later submission will be refused.

FEUILLES.OBTENTION: The shooter must obtain an official target sheet from the shooting range employee.
FEUILLES.PARTICIPATIONS: The number of participations is not limited during the year.
FEUILLES.FRAIS_TERRAIN: An additional $10 shooting range access fee applies for non-members.

VALIDATION.ESTAMPILLE: Each sheet must be stamped by the employee to be validated.
VALIDATION.DISTANCE: Targets must be positioned at a mandatory distance of 25 meters.
VALIDATION.REFUS_SIGNATURE: If the distance is not respected, the official cannot sign and the sheet will be considered invalid.

TRAITEMENT.CALCUL_MANUEL: Point calculation is performed manually by the organization’s officials.
TRAITEMENT.SAISIE_EXCEL: Results are entered into a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet.
TRAITEMENT.PRE_PUBLICATION: The provisional ranking will be published at the beginning of the following month.
TRAITEMENT.PRIX: Prize attribution is based on the official ranking established at the end of the competition.
TRAITEMENT.PRIX_DETAIL: For detailed information on distinctions, trophies, and rewards associated with the ranking, please refer to the section “
TRAITEMENT.PRIX_DETAIL2: ”, which specifies the evaluation criteria and the prizes awarded according to the ranking obtained.

TIRAGE.PARTICIPATIONS: Any purchased and returned target sheet automatically grants a participation right, whether used (shot) or not.
TIRAGE.EXPLICATION: The 50/50 draw is conducted only when the cumulative amount reaches a minimum of $100.
TIRAGE.AUCUN: No draw is held monthly or periodically if this minimum is not reached.
TIRAGE.EQUITABLE: The draw is conducted electronically using a random selection module integrated directly into the official competition application (digital fortune wheel), ensuring an impartial, transparent, and fair process.

DEROULEMENT.NOTE: Please consult the related sections for more details on the competition’s operation.

FEUILLEPOINTS.DIMENSIONS_TITRE: Dimensions of regular and elite targets
FEUILLEPOINTS.DIMENSIONS_INTRO: Provides the dimensions of each scoring ring as well as the size of the bonus point dot.

FEUILLEPOINTS.EPREUVE2: Shooting position: supported on shooting table.
FEUILLEPOINTS.EPREUVE6: Number of shots per sheet: unlimited*.
FEUILLEPOINTS.NOTE: See the Points Calculation section for qualified shots.

CALCULPOINTS.DESCRIPTION: This section explains the rules for calculating points for each target, including penalties and bonus points.
CALCULPOINTS.DESCRIPTION2: To standardize impact dimensions across the various authorized calibers and ensure fairness during scoring, an overlay template (.22 LR overlay) will be used for evaluating all targets.

TIRPARFAIT.DESCRIPTION: The shooter hits the center of the target without error and completely removes the central dot. They earn 10 base points plus 1 bonus point.

TIRSOLIDE.DESCRIPTION: The shooter hits the center of the target without error but does not completely remove the central dot. They earn 10 base points.

TIRINVALIDE.DESCRIPTION: The shot contains an error: double shot on the same target or shot off-target (within the frame but outside the scoring zone). No points are awarded.

TIRTRICHE.DESCRIPTION: A target is modified, replaced, or manipulated to artificially improve its score.
